Name: Slightly Bigger Farm
Author: FallSpice1
Description:
See above.

Answered questions:
- It doesn't replace the Standard Farm, it adds a new farm type that you can choose at the start.
- It keeps the big pond on the Standard Farm.
- This farm is legitimately huge. I named the mod Slightly Bigger Farm to be funny, but it's a [i]lot[/i] bigger. Don't be afraid to use mini-obelisks.
- Yes, it's got a lot of rocks. Yes, it's got a lot of debris. Yes, you'll probably never clear the whole farm all at once. It's meant for multiplayer.
- By 'multiplayer' I mean 'eight people', the farm is like half the size of the Valley. Grandpa was an economist.
